papers.title: Quantifying Gait Quality in Patients with Large-Head and Conventional Total Hip Arthroplasty—A Prospective Cohort Study
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery and Traumatology, Odense University Hospital, Odense, Denmark; Institute of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark, Odense, Denmark

corresponding_authors.name: Carsten Jensen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery and Traumatology, Odense University Hospital, Odense, Denmark; Institute of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark, Odense, Denmark

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术后的步态质量，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动等生物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on clinical gait analysis after THA, not on biomechanical modeling, stress shielding, micromotion, or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较大头与传统全髋关节置换术后的步态质量差异。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性队列研究，使用步态分析系统评估患者术后步态参数。
summary_zh.result: 大头组在部分步态参数上优于传统组，但总体差异有限。
summary_zh.validation: 临床步态数据采集与统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To compare gait quality between patients with large-head and conventional total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Prospective cohort study using gait analysis to assess spatiotemporal and kinematic parameters.
summary_en.result: Large-head THA showed modest improvements in some gait parameters compared to conventional THA.
summary_en.validation: Clinical gait data collection and statistical analysis.

papers.title: Lecture Engagement and Metamotivational States: Tracking and Intervention
papers.abstract: We studied the underlying motives governing studentsâ active learning in the classroom. Previous investigations indicate that during a standard lecture, student ratings of engagement decrease along with serious-mindedness (telic state). In each of two studies, a questionnaire packet was distributed to participants at the start of their 75-minute social psychology class. The instructor paused the lecture every 10 minutes (from Time 1 to Time 6) to assess the extent to which students were (a) serious-minded or telic and (b) engaged in the lecture. Results from Study 1 showed that both serious-mindedness and lecture engagement together dropped over the span of the lecture. In Study 2 we reasoned that by introducing a mid-lecture student group activity, both engagement and serious-mindedness would rebound. Between Time 3 and Time 4, students were given a group task to complete and discuss among each other. Compared to prior data (Study 1) without the activity after Time 3, engagement and serious-mindedness were significantly higher at Time 4 before falling again at Time 6. Educational implications and future directions are discussed.
papers.venue: Journal of Motivation Emotion and Personality Reversal Theory Studies

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究课堂学生参与度和心理状态，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA, surrogate modeling, optimization, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanical or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究课堂中学生参与度和严肃心态的变化规律
summary_zh.method: 每10分钟问卷评估学生状态，并引入小组活动干预
summary_zh.result: 小组活动后学生参与度和严肃心态显著回升
summary_zh.validation: 两个实验研究对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the temporal dynamics of student engagement and serious-mindedness during lectures.
summary_en.method: Repeated questionnaire measures every 10 minutes during a 75-minute lecture, with a group activity intervention in Study 2.
summary_en.result: The group activity significantly increased both engagement and serious-mindedness compared to the control condition.
summary_en.validation: Two empirical studies with within-subject comparisons.

papers.title: Effect of trunnion characteristics and assembly force on the head-¬‐neck taper strength of a modular hip implant

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究模块化髋关节假体头颈锥度连接强度，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或骨界面力学。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on head-neck taper strength and assembly force, not on proximal femur stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究模块化髋关节假体头颈锥度连接强度的影响因素
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测试不同锥度特征和装配力下的连接强度
summary_zh.result: 锥度特征和装配力显著影响头颈连接强度

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of trunnion characteristics and assembly force on the head-neck taper strength of modular hip implants.
summary_en.method: Experimental mechanical testing of taper connections under varying trunnion designs and assembly forces.
summary_en.result: Trunnion geometry and assembly force significantly influence taper strength.
